Primary sealing material: Garlock 1298 in die-formed rings.
Secondary sealing material: Alternating layers of wired reinforced-Fiberglass yarn or fiberglass filled Teflon washers.
Tight shutoff critical for molten salt applications; vendor to provide test results and leak test certificates.
Vendor to provide permanently installed cold box temperature monitor elements integrated into control valve monitor program.
Secondary seal area temperature must not exceed 450 deg. F.

Heat trace requirements to support a minimum operating temperature of 550 deg. F.
Gasket material: Spiral Thermiculite, Inconel 625.

Bolting materials: B7-2H Oxide coated / WCB.

Valve body with integral arrow indicating flow direction.
Valve stem travel scale with 'Open' and 'Close' positions.

The valve is designed to operate at high pressure and temperature conditions.
